title: AntiCrystal-Anchor
description: AntiCrystal-Anchor is a Plugin that prevents Players to craft & use Crystals and Anchors.
body:
# AntiCrystal-Anchor

**A powerful protection plugin that prevents End Crystal, Respawn Anchor and TNT abuse on your server — with granular control over crafting, placing, usage and explosions.**

## Key Features

* **End Crystal Protection:** Block crafting, placing, using, and even exploding End Crystals to prevent crystal PvP exploits. You can allow placing while still blocking explosions!

![Craft Crystals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3dda540efee0b4ff4e44c2e91a87f61c42de745.png)

![Placing Crystals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/259dc118626b8d061215efd39b46cc1f7da872bf.png)

* **Respawn Anchor Protection:** Prevent Respawn Anchor bombs in the Overworld and End dimensions.

![Craft Anchors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1d5e15343e9d75f982f3fb40af0f664a666e1d0.png)

![Place Anchors](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7488e3acbe7a41a06637a08154484db53f5716f7.png)

* **TNT Protection *(new in V1.2)*:** Optionally block TNT crafting, placing, igniting (redstone, fire, arrows, player), dispensing and explosions — fully independent from Crystal/Anchor settings.
* **Auto-Crafter Blocking:** Prevents crafting via the Crafter Block (1.21+) for all three item types — no more bypassing restrictions!
* **Granular Control:** Enable/disable each restriction independently per item.
* **World Filter:** Restrict the plugin to specific worlds via whitelist or blacklist.
* **Notification Types:** Choose how blocked-action messages appear — Chat, ActionBar, or Title.
* **Inventory Scanning:** Periodic inventory checks with configurable actions (notify, remove, or drop).
* **Admin Cooldown:** Configure a cooldown between admin notifications to prevent spam.
* **Bypass Permissions:** Allow trusted players to bypass restrictions per item type.
* **Multi-Language Support:** Fully translated in **English** and **German**.
* **Auto-Config Updates:** New config options are added automatically without losing your settings.

## Protection Options

| Item | Craft | Auto-Craft | Place | Use | Explosion |
| :--- | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: |
| End Crystal | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |
| Respawn Anchor | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | — |
| TNT *(optional)* | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ | ✅ |

## Commands & Permissions

| Role | Command / Permission | Description |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Admin | `/aca reload` · `anticrystalanchor.admin` | Reload configuration |
| Admin | `anticrystalanchor.notify` | Receive inventory-check notifications |
| Bypass | `anticrystalanchor.bypass.crystal` | Bypass End Crystal restrictions |
| Bypass | `anticrystalanchor.bypass.anchor` | Bypass Respawn Anchor restrictions |
| Bypass | `anticrystalanchor.bypass.tnt` | Bypass TNT restrictions |
| Bypass | `anticrystalanchor.bypass.all` / `bypass.*` | Bypass all restrictions |

---

## Configuration Highlights

```yaml
# End Crystal Settings
end-crystal:
  enabled: true
  block-craft: true
  block-autocraft: true   # Crafter Block (1.21+)
  block-place: true
  block-use: true
  remove-on-place: true
  block-explosion: false  # Allow placing, but no explosion damage

# Respawn Anchor Settings
respawn-anchor:
  enabled: true
  block-craft: true
  block-autocraft: true
  block-place: true
  block-use: true
  remove-on-place: true

# TNT Settings (disabled by default)
tnt:
  enabled: false
  block-craft: true
  block-autocraft: true
  block-place: true
  block-activate: true    # Redstone, fire, arrows, flint & steel
  block-dispenser: true   # Block TNT dispensing
  block-explosion: false  # Cancel all TNT explosions
  remove-on-place: true

# World Filter
worlds:
  mode: "blacklist"       # or "whitelist"
  list: []                # world names, empty = no filter

# Notification type for blocked-action messages
notifications:
  type: "chat"            # chat, actionbar, or title

# Inventory scanning
inventory-check:
  enabled: true
  interval: 60            # seconds
  action: "notify"        # notify, remove, or drop
  notify-player: true
  admin-cooldown: 30      # seconds between admin notifications per player
```

---

### Why Use This Plugin?

🛡️ **Prevent Grief:** Stop crystal, anchor and TNT bombing on your server  
⚔️ **Fair PvP:** Disable overpowered crystal PvP mechanics  
🔒 **Full Control:** Granular settings for each item and action  
🤖 **Auto-Crafter Proof:** Block 1.21+ Crafter Block exploits  
🌍 **World Filter:** Only protect specific worlds or exclude others  
📢 **Admin Alerts:** Get notified when players carry or attempt blocked actions

---

### Dependencies (optional)

**We recommend installing LuckPerms** for a better permission management experience!
